name: East River Bridge South Tower

name: Buoy Red 12
description: The red navigation buoy at channel marker 12

name: Building Rooftop Corner

name: Pier End

name: Smokestack Top
description: The rim of the nearest smokestack

name: Water Tower
description: The top of the round water tower on the roof
